conclusion: Organic tree support body and same-layer interface paths must be kept spatially disjoint even when the top Z gap is nonzero and support/interface use the same extruder. The previous keepout was gated on zero_gap_interface_top and non-mergeable filaments, so this project skipped it. Removing those gates trims the expanded interface footprint from organic support-body polygons. On the supplied project this reduced interface sections from 302 to 280, preserved 19,560 closed outer walls with zero nonclosed walls, passed 316 focused native assertions, and produced no warning/error lines. The canonical output intentionally changes because the mixed interface segments are removed; no physical print trial is included.
